operating_notes.text: IPO proceeds of ₹185 Cr are monitored by CARE Ratings, which filed its quarterly monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Baazar Style Retail allotted 15,00,000 equity shares at ₹328.25 per share upon conversion of warrants to Cupid Limited.
Private label contributed 53% of FY26 revenue at ₹977 Cr, with the Square Up brand at ₹406.3 Cr.
Same store sales growth was 3% in FY26.
Inventory days improved to 119 in FY26 from 129 in FY25, and trade payable days rose to 104 from 47.9.
Incorporated renewable energy subsidiary Sunright/Sunlight Private Limited.

timeline.summary: Shreyans Surana, Promoter of Baazar Style Retail Limited, declared no encumbrance of shares for the promoter group during FY2026 ended March 31, 2026.
Baazar Style Retail filed the CARE Ratings monitoring agency report showing nil deviation in IPO proceeds utilization for Q4 FY26 on May 14, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹465.71 Cr, net loss ₹25.64 Cr (against a loss of ₹6.39 Cr a year earlier).

Baazar Style Retail's Q4 & FY26 investor presentation showed FY26 revenue up 37% to ₹1,841 Cr and PAT up 220% to ₹46.9 Cr, while Q4FY26 swung to a ₹25.6 Cr loss on a ₹20.6 Cr insurance settlement charge; it also disclosed a ₹331.53 Cr preferential warrant issue to Cupid Limited and raised annual store-addition guidance to 60–80.
Promoters Pradeep Kumar Agarwal, Shreyans Surana, Rohit Kedia, and Bhagwan Prasad declared no share encumbrances for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on April 3–6, 2026.
Baazar Style Retail allotted 20 lakh shares raising ₹65.65 Cr via warrant conversion and approved incorporation of a solar subsidiary on October 15, 2026.
